cases.penalty: Fine and/or imprisonment of up to a few years

cases.penalty: Imprisonment of up to 15 years and fines
cases.scenario: Greg, a building inspector, was handed an envelope containing 5,000 dollars by a contractor named Sofia. In the same conversation, Greg agreed to approve a construction project that had not yet passed its safety checks.

cases.crime: Controlling or coercive behaviour in an intimate or family relationship
cases.penalty: Up to 5 years imprisonment, a fine, or both

cases.penalty: Fines, imprisonment and caning for male offenders
cases.scenario: Wei Ling uses a can of spray paint to write a large slogan on the wall of a public underpass late at night. The paint cannot be removed by simple washing and the wall must be repainted.

cases.crime: Invasion of land or buildings (occupying property without permission)
cases.penalty: Imprisonment of up to 4 years and a fine
cases.scenario: Paolo and several friends enter a vacant, privately owned apartment building by forcing a side door. They move in mattresses and live there for several weeks, saying the owner has left it empty for years.

cases.penalty: Fine or imprisonment of up to 1 year
cases.scenario: Anders climbs over a fence and enters a neighbor's fenced backyard at night, then walks up to a window and looks inside. The residents, Karin and her husband, are at home and see him at the glass.

cases.crime: Obstructing police officers (including failing to comply with lawful orders)
cases.scenario: Dmitri stands near a group of officers who are detaining a man at a public square and films them on his phone. When an officer tells him to step back, he moves closer to keep the whole scene in frame and keeps recording.

cases.crime: Sharing obscene or private sexual images without consent (under IT law)
cases.penalty: Imprisonment up to 3 years and a fine
cases.scenario: After a breakup, Rohan sends several intimate photos of his former girlfriend Priya to a group chat of their mutual friends. She had given him the photos privately and never agreed to their being shared.

cases.crime: Failure to disclose a password or key under investigatory powers
cases.penalty: Up to 2 years imprisonment, or up to 5 years in national security or child indecency cases
cases.scenario: Tom's laptop is lawfully seized during an investigation, and officers ask him to provide the password to unlock his encrypted files. He says he remembers it but declines to enter it.

cases.penalty: Fine or imprisonment of up to 3 years
